summary: The audit checks the 30 units, each letter graded with a C or better (at most 1 S-graded unit counts): one 5-unit core course, 20 units from one pathway, and 5 units of additional IR coursework you move in (pre-approved or petitioned), with at most 5 units of directed reading. The minor's courses cannot also count toward your major or another minor. Checked by hand: the Minor Declaration and Course Proposal form, and up to 10 non-Stanford units with approval.

program.why: Grading: "All courses counting toward the minor must be taken for a LETTER GRADE and receive a 'C' or better."

totals.label: S-graded IR units
totals.why: Grading: "Up to 1 unit of IR pre-approved or petitioned coursework that is not offered for a letter grade may be applied toward IR specialization or filler coursework, if completed for an 'S' grade."

totals.label: Directed reading (INTNLREL 197)
totals.why: Policies: "Up to five units of pre-approved Directed Reading can be counted towards your IR minor requirements."
